title: What is the Spatial Intelligence slider?
summary: A visual metaphor for spatial grounding: blur represents uncertainty, not a measured AI confidence score.
body: The Spatial Intelligence slider is a frontend visual metaphor for spatial grounding in a world-model interface. It changes only the canvas blur; it does not change a model's actual knowledge, confidence or perception. The 100% Human end represents clear, grounded spatial representation. The 0% AI end uses strong blur to represent uncertainty, incomplete learned representation and unresolved spatial relationships. The middle suggests partial inference between a structured but uncertain representation and a more grounded view.
